title: EPUB reading and local backups.
summary: Try a chapter before saving it. Choose EPUB or PDF from the library, check storage health and keep a backup in a local folder.

title: Library additions
summary: Discover 5,000 complete books across the collection, with a fresh selection each time you open the app. Add your next read straight to your personal shelf.

title: Reading preferences
summary: Choose your desk, paper and hardcover. Set the mood with ambience, adjust EPUB typography and follow your reading rhythm.

title: Backups and device transfer
summary: Back up your books and reading progress, transfer them between devices and export your notes. Reopen saved books offline.

title: Notes and reading tools
summary: Highlight, draw, bookmark and write margin notes. Listen aloud, look up a word or combine your own files.

title: Public library
summary: Discover complete classics by title, author or genre. Read edition details and add a book to your shelf.

title: PDF reading and your shelf
summary: Book-style page turns, a personal shelf and saved reading positions. Free to read, with no account needed.
